name: PR439 W6 pre-fix discriminator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-w6-prefixtest

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  pre-fix-regression:
    name: W6 pre-fix regression must fail
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Prove Resolve attachment regression is red before the fix
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          set +e
          bash tools/dotnet-ci/run-gate.sh --fast \
            --test-filter 'Name=ControlledKeeper_ReattachesAfterResolveCollisionCorrection' \
            2>&1 | tee pr439-w6-prefix.log
          status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          set -e

          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Pre-fix discriminator unexpectedly passed on f69aaef0-derived code."
            exit 1
          fi

          if ! grep -F "Failed ControlledKeeper_ReattachesAfterResolveCollisionCorrection" \
            pr439-w6-prefix.log >/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::Gate failed, but not at the intended W6 attachment regression."
            cat pr439-w6-prefix.log
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "::notice::Expected pre-fix failure reproduced: Resolve collision correction detaches the Controlled keeper."
